text: {"assertions":["A flapping flag bug was fixed in platform/featureflags/eval.go where flag evaluator decisions alternated between calls.","The bug occurred when two requests raced on the same key.","The root cause was a cache entry that was never invalidated on write.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction in PR #2314 on branch fix/flapping-flag-1.","The bug can be reproduced by repeatedly evaluating the same flag for one user.","The covering test is located in platform/featureflags/eval_test.go.","The fix reclaimed 7 GB of blob storage."]}
